description: Lichtsignalanlagen Hafen Hamburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Transparenzportal Hamburg. Der Datensatz enthält Lage, Namen und Knotennummer aller Lichtsignalanlagen im Hamburger Hafengebiet in Zuständigkeit der HPA (Hamburg Port Authority). Coverage: Transparenzportal Hamburg. The portal files it under the publisher Transparenzportal Hamburg. Its tags are geodaten, hvd. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, OAF, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
